_process: See docs/vulnerability_scanning.md for the exception process and approval requirements.

_format.vuln_id: CVE or GHSA identifier from pip-audit output
_format.reason: Why immediate remediation is not possible
_format.tracking_issue: GitHub issue URL tracking the fix
_format.expires: ISO-8601 expiry date (max 90 days from approval for HIGH/CRITICAL)

waivers._comment: EXAMPLE WAIVER — demonstrating the exception process per issue #967.
waivers._note: This waiver is for documentation purposes. In production, waivers must reference real CVEs.
waivers.reason: The vulnerable code path (example_function) is never reachable from LedgerLens ingestion or detection pipelines. The package is used only in an optional development-time script (scripts/sandbox.py) that never runs in production or CI.
waivers.mitigation: Production container image is built without dev-only dependencies (see Dockerfile). The vulnerable function is not called anywhere in the call graph (verified by scripts/detect_dead_paths.py).
